# The Newport Maeve Chronicles

> A dark fantasy series by Dean Jordanov, set in an alternate world of vampires, angels, and demonic forces alongside an industrial age of brass, steam, and ruthless ambition. The story follows Miroslav Dion, the world's first vampire, as a demonic threat rises in the city of Newport Maeve.

The prequel audiobook is available on YouTube. This site is the official home of the series, with character profiles, the world and its districts, and links to the wider Chronicles community.

## Main
- [Home](https://newportmaeve.com/): Series overview, the prequel audiobook, characters, the city, and the author.
- [Newport Maeve — The City](https://newportmaeve.com/city.html): The industrial metropolis at the heart of the series and its districts (Market, Industrial, NorthPort, Living A, Living B, Luxury, and the Military Base).

## Characters
- [Miroslav Dion](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/miroslav-dion.html): The first of the Blood Blessed, and the last line when the dark comes calling.
- [The Protector](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/the-protector.html): An angel bound to Newport Maeve, sworn to hold the line against what claws at the world's thin places.
- [The Unknown Emissary](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/the-unknown-emissary.html): A messenger of the One True who walks through centuries as if through a quiet hall.
- [George L'Aris](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/george-laris.html): An enforcer of the Ironclad Consortium, caught between the thirst that makes beasts and the duty that makes monsters.
- [Aland](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/aland.html): An orphan who learned that a hungry city will always open its hand if you give it a reason.
- [Unnamed Bride](https://newportmaeve.com/characters/unnamed-bride.html): Promised away in a Civic Center wedding, she escaped one fate only to collide with another.

## Listen
- [Prequel Audiobook (YouTube)](https://youtu.be/gg5DZfQgrho): "Miroslav Dion: A Glimpse of Centuries Past" — the official prequel.

## About

- Genre: Dark fantasy, urban gothic, gaslamp / steampunk
